subject: Entity identity & PO path — Tidewood Labs onboarding
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@tidewood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entity identity & PO path — Tidewood Labs onboarding

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the chat earlier — excited to get Tidewood live as a preferred supplier. To complete the vendor master and ensure POs route correctly to your AP team, could you please provide the following items: 

- Legal entity name as it should appear on contracts and invoices
- Registered address (legal HQ) + remit address if different
- Preferred PO contact (name, title, email, phone)
- Invoice recipient and required invoice fields (PO number required? GL fields?)
- Tax form (W-9 or W-8 as applicable) and a PDF of your bank remittance details for ACH setup
- Any required vendor code/identifier on your side we should reference

I’ve attached our standard vendor_onboarding_form.pdf to collect the above — if easier, you can fill that and return. Once we have the items above, Kim (AP intake) will create the vendor master record and confirm the PO routing. Our target for first PO is week of Aug 16, so if you can get the packet back by Aug 7 that would be ideal.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Hi Rishi,

Appreciate the clear checklist. Please find everything attached: Tidewood_W9.pdf and Tidewood_Bank_Remittance.pdf. Below are the quick answers in-line so you can start the record: 

- Legal entity name: Tidewood Labs, Inc.
- Registered address: 180 Harbor Point Drive, Suite 200, Boston, MA 02110
- Remit address: Same as registered address (we will accept ACH to bank above)
- Preferred PO contact: Jessica Morales, AP Manager — jessica.morales@tidewood.com, +1 617-555-2233
- Invoice recipient: accounts@tidewood.com. Please include PO number on all invoices; line-level GL codes are not required at submission.
- Vendor code: TW-0012 (our internal vendor id)

We’ve also filled your vendor_onboarding_form and attached it as vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf. 

Attachments: Tidewood_W9.pdf (application/pdf, stub), Tidewood_Bank_Remittance.pdf (application/pdf, stub), vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (application/pdf, stub)

Let me know if you need a certified copy of our articles or anything notarized — happy to provide.

Best,

Director, Partnerships — Tidewood Labs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@tidewood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entity identity & PO path — Tidewood Labs onboarding

Thanks Emma — that’s very helpful and straightforward. A couple quick follow-ups so AP can finish the vendor master: 

1) For bank/ACH setup our bank ops team needs a remittance PDF that clearly shows account number and ACH routing OR a bank letter. The bank_remittance.pdf you sent is fine, but can you confirm the account name exactly (must match legal entity) and whether the account accepts ACH transfers from U.S. banks?

2) We require one proof of legal existence for the vendor file (certificate of good standing or articles of incorporation). If you can attach a PDF we’ll add it to the record.

3) Can you confirm whether Tidewood is registered for sales tax in MA (we record tax jurisdictions for invoicing metadata)?

Once we have that last bit we’ll create the vendor master record and provide the Redwood vendor id (for your reference). I’ll also create the PO route so POs go to accounts@tidewood.com automatically.

If it’s easier to upload files to this shared drive folder I can add a one-time secure upload link — tell me what you prefer.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole | Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Emma Carter <emma.carter@tidewood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jessica Morales <jessica.morales@tidewood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:35:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Entity identity & PO path — Tidewood Labs onboarding

Hi Marissa — thanks for the checklist, and apologies for the delay. Quick answers below and I uploaded the requested docs to your Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tidewood-onboarding

- Bank account name: Tidewood Labs, Inc. — accepts ACH from U.S. banks (domestic ACH OK)
- Proof of legal existence: Tidewood_Articles_of_Incorporation.pdf uploaded to the folder
- Sales tax registration: Tidewood is registered in MA (Massachusetts Sales Tax Account: MA-785022)

We also confirmed with AP that Jessica will monitor accounts@tidewood.com for incoming POs and invoice remittance. Please send the Redwood vendor id and the first PO when ready — Jessica will match and confirm once received.

Thanks again — excited to get started.

Emma
